description: This file defines the SNApiService class, which implements various API-related interfaces for handling user sessions, file uploads, synchronization, and settings in a client-server architecture. It manages HTTP requests, session state, and error handling for the Standard Notes platform.

classes.name: SNApiService
classes.description: A service class managing API interactions, session state, file operations, and synchronization for the Standard Notes platform.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the current user object.

methods.name: setInvalidSessionObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer callback to notify when an invalid session (revoked or expired) is detected.

methods.name: loadHost
methods.description: Loads the server host URL from storage or uses the current host.

methods.name: setHost
methods.description: Sets a new server host URL and persists it.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the current server host URL.

methods.name: isThirdPartyHostUsed
methods.description: Checks if the current host is a third-party host.

methods.name: getFilesHost
methods.description: Returns the files server host URL.

methods.name: setSession
methods.description: Sets the current session object and optionally persists it.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves the current session object.

methods.name: apiVersion
methods.description: Returns the API version string.

methods.name: createErrorResponse
methods.description: Creates a standardized error response object.

methods.name: errorResponseWithFallbackMessage
methods.description: Ensures error message fallback in error responses.

methods.name: processMetaObject
methods.description: Processes response meta data, updating user info and server URLs.

methods.name: processSuccessResponseForMetaBody
methods.description: Processes successful responses to extract meta data.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with error handling and meta processing.

methods.name: getAccountKeyParams
methods.description: Obtains account key parameters, handling MFA if needed.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Performs user sign-in with email and password.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs out the current user.

methods.name: changeCredentials
methods.description: Changes user credentials including password and email.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Synchronizes data with the server using provided payloads and tokens.

methods.name: refreshSession
methods.description: Refreshes the current user session tokens.

methods.name: getSessionsList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of active sessions.

methods.name: deleteSession
methods.description: Deletes a specified session.

methods.name: getUserFeatures
methods.description: Fetches features available to a user.

methods.name: tokenRefreshableRequest
methods.description: Performs a request that can trigger token refresh on failure.

methods.name: listSettings
methods.description: Lists user settings.

methods.name: updateSetting
methods.description: Updates a user setting.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Retrieves a specific user setting.

methods.name: getSubscriptionSetting
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription-related setting.

methods.name: deleteSetting
methods.description: Deletes a user setting.

methods.name: downloadFeatureUrl
methods.description: Downloads a feature URL.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Fetches subscription details for a user.

methods.name: getAvailableSubscriptions
methods.description: Lists available subscriptions.

methods.name: getNewSubscriptionToken
methods.description: Obtains a new subscription token.

methods.name: downloadOfflineFeaturesFromRepo
methods.description: Downloads offline features from a repository, with host validation.

methods.name: registerForListedAccount
methods.description: Registers the current user for a listed account.

methods.name: createFileValetToken
methods.description: Creates a valet token for file operations.

methods.name: startUploadSession
methods.description: Starts a file upload session.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a file using a valet token.

methods.name: uploadFileBytes
methods.description: Uploads a chunk of file bytes.

methods.name: closeUploadSession
methods.description: Closes an ongoing upload session.

methods.name: getFilesDownloadUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for downloading file chunks.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads a file chunk, handling range headers and callbacks.

methods.name: checkIntegrity
methods.description: Checks data integrity with provided payloads.

methods.name: getSingleItem
methods.description: Fetches a single item by UUID.

methods.name: preprocessingError
methods.description: Checks for ongoing session refresh or invalid session errors.

methods.name: preprocessAuthenticatedErrorResponse
methods.description: Handles 401 Unauthorized responses, notifying observer if session revoked.

methods.name: getSessionAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves the current session's access token.

methods.name: getDiagnostics
methods.description: Provides diagnostic info about the API service state.
